text:
liam: Pushed a rollback PR for canary — we're seeing ~4x 5xx on the canary after the connpool tweak. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4286. Can someone take a quick look and merge if it looks sane?

maria-ops: oncall here, pulling logs and canary metric dashboards now.

liam: canary service: kv-proxy-canary, pod: kv-proxy-canary-7f9d

liam: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-17T14:12:03Z ERROR connection reset by peer
2026-03-17T14:12:05Z WARN slow call duration=120ms
2026-03-17T14:12:07Z ERROR upstream 502
```

ajenkins: reproducing locally with same config, looks like backoff logic regressed when pool size < 2.

kevin: quick skim — PR is straightforward. I'd like a unit test for the backoff but given SLA impact i'm +1 to merge and follow up with tests. tagging @ajenkins to confirm no behavioral surprises.

ajenkins: i ran e2e against canary image, failures drop after rollback. +1.

maria-ops: agree with kevin, recommend merge+monitor for 15m then decide rollforward.

kevin: approve. merging now.

deploy-bot: Merged PR #4286 into release/canary at commit abc123 by kevin. Canary rollback started.

oncall-bot: Alert: canary 5xx spike detected at 1793502501 — monitoring.

oncall-bot: Alert cleared for canary 5xx spike at 1793502602.

liam: thanks everyone — i'll open a follow-up ticket to add the unit test and add a feature-flag for the connpool change so rollforward is safer.

maria-ops: i'll annotate the incident in postmortems and add a short note for oncall runbook. :thumbsup:

kevin: nice quick turn. leaving a small code comment in the PR re: edge case.

liam: noted, will address in the follow-up.

ajenkins: watching metrics for the next 15m, will ping if anything odd.

maria-ops: sounds good — closing thread when metrics stable.
